Phibar[jj] Eps[ii, jj]`. Never contract `LLbar[ii]` with `Phibar[ii]`. Model the SM Yukawas: `QLbar.dR Phi[ii]`, `LLbar.lR Phi[ii]`, `QLbar.uR Phibar[jj] Eps[ii, jj]`.

5. New U(1) charges. Do not copy a paper's charge table literally when the paper's Yukawa equation and its table use different hypercharge conventions (for example the paper effectively uses Y(H) = -1/2). Re-derive the new-U(1) charge of every SM field, including the Higgs, from the requirement that all SM Yukawas and all new Yukawas are invariant under SM.fr conventions. Report which sign you chose and why. Do not put quantum numbers on a `SelfConjugate -> True` class; put a chiral charge on an Unphysical chiral class instead.

6. Read only the paper. Do not open any cached or reference `.fr` file for the same model. If you see one, say so in the output and do not use it.

7. Fractions and roots in extracted equations. The paper text is machine-extracted. A displayed fraction or radical can arrive flattened: the numerator, the fraction bar and the denominator become separate lines, so `A / Sqrt[B]` and `A Sqrt[B]` look identical. For every coefficient that contains a fraction, a square root or a power:
   - If a LaTeX source file (`*_source.tex`) is available, read the `\frac{...}{...}` and `\sqrt{...}` there and take it literally. The LaTeX is authoritative over the flattened text.
   - Otherwise cross-check the placement against a second equation of the paper that depends on the same coefficient (a partial width, a cross section, a limit, or a small-parameter expansion) and name that equation in the self-audit. A coupling `g/Sqrt[1-x]` gives a width proportional to `1/(1-x)`; a coupling `g Sqrt[1-x]` gives a width proportional to `(1-x)`.
   - If neither resolves it, choose the form that reproduces a numerical value the paper states, and say so.
   Never silently pick one placement.

8. Mass mixing. When the paper diagonalises a mass mixing between a new state and an SM state (Z-Z', h-S, W-W_R, nu-N), write the mass eigenstates the paper uses: declare the mixing angle (External, or Internal with the paper's formula) and express the gauge eigenstates through it in `Definitions` of Unphysical classes. Do not leave the mixing in a comment.

## FeynRules and UFO construct rules (each one broke a compile or a MadGraph import in earlier runs)

9. Non-fundamental colour representations. If a field carries a colour index other than the triplet `Colour` or the adjoint `Gluon` (for example a sextet), declare the index range AND add the representation line FeynRules needs, before the field declarations: `AddGaugeRepresentation[SU3C -> {T6, Sextet}];` for a sextet (schema: put both lines in `raw_preamble`; also keep the `index_decls` entry). Write covariant derivatives on the whole field, `DC[Phi, mu]`, never with an explicit colour index inside `DC[...]`.

10. Names. Class names, parameter names and index names must not be Mathematica built-ins or FeynRules symbols: never `N`, `C`, `D`, `E`, `I`, `K`, `O`, `HC`, `CC`, `FS`, `DC`, `del`, `Eps`, `Ga`, `ProjP`, `ProjM`, and never a name SM.fr already declares (`H`, `Phi`, `Z`, `W`, `A`, `G`, `ee`, `gs`, `gw`, `sw`, `cw`, `vev`, `MZ`, `MW`, ...). No primes or punctuation in `ParticleName`/`AntiParticleName` (`W'` is not a valid UFO name; write `Wp`, `Wpbar`). Use class indices of 100 or more for new classes.

11. Interaction orders. Every new coupling parameter (Yukawa, portal, quartic, new gauge coupling, dimensionless EFT coefficient) carries an `InteractionOrder`: `{NP, 1}` for a new-physics coupling, `{QED, 1}` or `{QCD, 1}` only when it is literally that coupling. Declare `M$InteractionOrderHierarchy` with every order you use (for example `{{QCD, 1}, {QED, 2}, {NP, 1}}`). A coupling with no order makes MadGraph reject the UFO ("Some couplings have '1' order").

12. Tensor parameters. Give every indexed parameter explicit per-component values (`yN[1,1] -> 0.1, yN[1,2] -> 0, ...`; schema: `value_rules`). Never use a pattern rule such as `X[i_?NumericQ, j_?NumericQ] :> ...` in `Definitions`: FeynRules exports the pattern verbatim as a UFO parameter name and MadGraph fails with an unrelated "invalid syntax" error.

13. Flavour structure in matrix form. Write generation-space couplings as matrix products between class fields, `uqbar.VCKMR.Ga[mu].ProjP.dq`, `LLbar.yN.NR`, `ISbar.Ga[mu].ProjM.IS`, not as explicit index sums `VCKMR[ff1, ff2] uqbar[ff1, cc]...dq[ff2, cc]`, and never nest one generation index inside another. Explicit-index forms leak FeynRules internals (`ConvertSpinToString`, `MakeIdenticalFermions`) into the UFO.

14. One declared total. Define exactly one Lagrangian term named `LTotal` that sums every other term you define, and make sure every other term appears in that sum. Do not define two alternative totals. Do not emit a term that contains no field (a pure constant): FeynRules exports it as a vertex with no particles.

15. Declarations. Every field used in a term is declared; every parameter used in a term is declared with a numeric default; every `SelfConjugate -> True` class has no `QuantumNumbers`; a Majorana mass term is `-1/2 M psibar.psi`.

For every Lagrangian term you emit, output one row of this table. Then fix any row that fails before you write the model.

| term name | fields in the monomial | operator mass dimension d | coupling symbol | coupling mass dimension (must be 4 - d) | 1/Lambda power present (must be d - 4, or "n/a" if d <= 4) | Q sum | Y sum | SU(2) contraction (singlet? which Eps or shared index) | SU(3) contraction | sum of each new U(1) charge (one column per U(1), must be 0) | lepton/baryon number sum (if the paper assigns them) | CC[] used where paper writes psi^c (yes/no/n/a) | fraction/root placement checked against (equation, LaTeX line, or "n/a") | Hermitian partner (HC[] or self-conjugate) |

Rules for the table:
- Field mass dimensions: scalar 1, vector 1, fermion 3/2, `FS[...]` 2, `del`/`DC` 1.
- Every Q sum, Y sum, and new-U(1) sum must equal 0. Use the charges you declared in `QuantumNumbers` and the SM.fr charges for SM fields. If a sum is not 0, the term is wrong; fix the contraction or the charge before you continue.

- Add one line that lists every class, parameter and index name you chose and confirms none is a Mathematica built-in, a FeynRules symbol, or an SM.fr name.
- Add one line that names the single total Lagrangian and lists the terms it sums.
- Add one line that states whether any reference or cached model file was read (must be "none").

10:   compile  - FeynRules will not load or will not finish the model
11:   checks   - the model loads but a consistency check fails
12:   mg5      - the UFO is written but MadGraph rejects it
13:   harness  - the validation harness cannot pick the total Lagrangian

77: def strip_comments(text: str) -> str:
78:     out, depth, i = [], 0, 0
79:     while i < len(text):
80:         if text.startswith("(*", i):
81:             depth += 1
82:             i += 2
83:             continue
84:         if text.startswith("*)", i) and depth:
85:             depth -= 1
86:             i += 2
87:             continue
88:         if depth == 0:
89:             out.append(text[i])
90:         elif text[i] == "\n":
91:             out.append("\n")
92:         i += 1
93:     return "".join(out)

95: 
96: def _matching(text: str, open_idx: int) -> int:
97:     depth = 0
98:     pairs = {"{": "}", "[": "]", "(": ")"}
99:     closes = set(pairs.values())
100:     for j in range(open_idx, len(text)):
101:         ch = text[j]
102:         if ch in pairs:
103:             depth += 1
104:         elif ch in closes:
105:             depth -= 1
106:             if depth == 0:
107:                 return j
108:     return len(text) - 1

111: def _block(text: str, name: str) -> str:
112:     m = re.search(rf"M\${name}\s*=\s*\{{", text)
113:     if not m:
114:         return ""
115:     end = _matching(text, m.end() - 1)
116:     return text[m.end():end]

118: 
119: def _entries(block: str) -> List[Dict]:
120:     """Top-level `Head == { ... }` entries of a M$ block."""
121:     out = []
122:     for m in re.finditer(r"(\w+(?:\[\s*\d+\s*\])?)\s*==\s*\{", block):
123:         end = _matching(block, m.end() - 1)
124:         body = block[m.end():end]
125:         out.append({"head": m.group(1), "body": body, "pos": m.start()})
126:     return out

129: def _prop(body: str, key: str) -> Optional[str]:
130:     m = re.search(rf"\b{key}\s*->\s*", body)
131:     if not m:
132:         return None
133:     rest = body[m.end():]
134:     if rest.startswith("{"):
135:         return rest[: _matching(rest, 0) + 1]
136:     mm = re.match(r"[^,}\n]+", rest)

144: def term_defs(text: str) -> List[Dict]:
145:     starts = [(m.group(1), m.start()) for m in re.finditer(r"^(L\w+)\s*:?=", text, re.M)]
146:     stops = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(r"^(?:M\$\w+\s*=|L\w+\s*:?=|\w+\s*=\s*\{)", text, re.M)]
147:     out = []
148:     for name, s in starts:

150:         out.append({"name": name, "body": text[s:e], "line": text[:s].count("\n") + 1})

154: def _line_of(text: str, needle: str) -> Optional[int]:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Deterministic lints for an agent-written FeynRules add-on (.fr) file.

Every rule encodes one construct that broke a compile, a FeynRules check or a
MadGraph import in the benchmark (prompt_addendum_v3.txt rules 9-15 and the
repair-loop taxonomy). A lint runs in milliseconds on the text; the compile it
predicts takes up to 900 s.

Each finding carries the STAGE it predicts:
  compile  - FeynRules will not load or will not finish the model
  checks   - the model loads but a consistency check fails
  mg5      - the UFO is written but MadGraph rejects it
  harness  - the validation harness cannot pick the total Lagrangian
  warn     - FeynRules warns; the run may still pass

Library: ``lint_text(text) -> list[Finding]``. CLI: ``fr_lint.py file.fr``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

539: \section{LQ Lagrangian}
540: \label{sec:LQLagrangian}
541: The five possible scalar LQ representations $\Phi_1, \Phi_{\tilde{1}}, \Phi_2, \Phi_{\tilde{2}}, \Phi_3$ transform under the $SU(3)_c \times SU(2)_L \times U(1)_Y$ gauge group as~\cite{Buchmuller:1986zs} 
542: 
543: 
544: \begin{equation}
545: \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.1}
546:     \centering
547:     \begin{tabular}{c | c c c c c}
548:          & $\Phi_1,$ & $\Phi_{\tilde{1}}$ & $\Phi_2$ & $ \Phi_{\tilde{2}}$ & $\Phi_3$\\ \hline
549:     	$SU(3)_c$ & 3 & 3 & 3 & 3 & 3 \\
550:     	$SU(2)_L$ & 1 & 1 & 2 & 2 & 3 \\
551:     	$U(1)_Y$ & $-\frac{1}{3}$ & $-\frac{4}{3}$ & $\frac{7}{6}$ & $\frac{1}{6}$ & $-\frac{1}{3}$
552:     \end{tabular}\,.
553: \end{equation}
554: 
555: 
556: Note that we adopt the convention that all scalar LQs transform in the fundamental $SU(3)_c$ representation. Expanding the $SU(2)_L$ multiplets into their components, the following electric charge eigenstates are found
557: 
558: 
559: \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.5}
560: \begin{align}
561:     \begin{aligned}
562:         \Phi_1 = \left( \Phi_1^{-1/3}\right), \ 
563:         \Phi_{\tilde{1}} = \left( \Phi_{\tilde{1}}^{-4/3}\right), \ 
564:         \Phi_2 = \begin{pmatrix} \Phi^{+5/3}_2 \\ \Phi^{+2/3}_2 \end{pmatrix},\ \\
565:         \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.5}
566:         \Phi_{\tilde{2}} = \begin{pmatrix} \Phi^{+2/3}_{\tilde{2}} \\ \Phi^{-1/3}_{\tilde{2}} \end{pmatrix},\ 
567:         \sigma \cdot \Phi_{3} = \begin{pmatrix}
568:             \Phi_3^{-1/3} & \sqrt{2} \Phi_3^{+2/3} \\
569:             \sqrt{2} \Phi_3^{-4/3} & -\Phi_3^{-1/3}
570:         \end{pmatrix}\,. 
571:     \end{aligned}
572: \end{align}
573: 
574: 
575: We decompose the scalar LQ Lagrangian as
576: 
577: 
578: \begin{equation}
579:     \mathcal{L}^{\text{LQ}} = \mathcal{L}_{2 \Phi} + \mathcal{L}_{\text{kin}} +
580:     \mathcal{L}_{\text{f}}  + \mathcal{L}_{3 \Phi} + \mathcal{L}_{4 \Phi} \,,
581: \end{equation}

The individual parts of the Lagrangians are discussed in more detail below. 
585: 
586: 
587: 
588: \subsection{LQ Masses and Higgs Interactions ($\mathcal{L}_{2 \Phi}$)}
589: \label{sec:LQ-Higgs}
590: The LQ masses and the LQ-LQ-Higgs(-Higgs) interactions are implemented by the Lagrangian \cite{Crivellin:2020ukd, Hirsch:1996qy}
591: 
592: 
593: \begin{equation}
594:     \begin{aligned}
595:         \mathcal{L}_{2\Phi} 
596:         = &- \sum_{a = 1}^3\big(m_{a}^2+Y_{a} \left(H^{\dagger}H\right)\big)\big(\Phi_a^{\dagger}\Phi_a\big)
597:         - \sum_{a = 1}^2 \big(m_{\tilde a}^2+Y_{\tilde a} \left(H^{\dagger}H\right) \big)\big(\Phi_{\tilde a}^{\dagger}\Phi_{\tilde a}\big) \\

599:         - Y_{\tilde{2}\tilde{2}} \big(H^\intercal i\sigma_{2} \Phi_{\tilde{2}} \big)^\dagger \big(H^\intercal i\sigma_{2} \Phi_{\tilde{2}} \big) \\

## Objective
- Read TASK.md and execute it: extract the complete new-physics content of the SLQrules model (arXiv:2105.04844) into a `spec.json` FeynRulesModel object, run `./frgen spec.json`, iterate until schema + lint pass, and end with a self-audit message.
- Work only inside `/private/var/folders/pf/fm0v0g_52r754cfv3r4lqv980000gn/T/ob-SLQrules-e1vaqirb/`

## Important Details
- TASK.md rules: `model_name` = `"SLQrules_gen"`; all numeric physics values are STRINGS (`"-1/3"`, `"1500."`); SM add-on ⇒ `gauge_groups []`; indices Colour/Gluon/Generation/SU2D/SU2W need no `index_decls`; others need `index_decls` (`range_kind "NoUnfold"`, correct size); unique `class_index` per particle (use ≥100); `self_conjugate=false` for complex fields.
- COMPLETENESS IS SCORED: every new state as a separate ParticleClass (or `class_members`); new coupling/mass/mixing params (External unless clearly derived); main new-physics `lagrangian_terms` verbatim with FeynRules idioms.
- Rule 1 (exact): free-field kinetic+mass term for EVERY new particle class using the class's `Mass -> {M, value}` symbol, added to the total sum; complex scalar template is index-less: `DC[phibar, mu] DC[phi, mu] - Mphi^2 phibar phi`. Rule 14: exactly ONE root term `LTotal` summing all others; no fieldless/constant terms. Rule 15: every param used in a term declared with a numeric default. Rule 11: new couplings get `InteractionOrder {NP,1}` (hierarchy e.g. `{{QCD,1},{QED,2},{NP,1}}`). Rule 12: tensor params need explicit per-component `value_rules`, no pattern rules. Rule 13: flavour as matrix products between class fields, never explicit generation-index sums. Rules 3–4: CC idioms (`CC[psi]`, `bar[CC[psi]]`), Eps pairing for same-conjugation SU2 doublets (verified charge bookkeeping: Y1LL MUST use Eps: `Q̄^c1 L2 − Q̄^c2 L1` both neutral).
- Final message = self-audit: table per Lagrangian term with Q/Y/SU2/SU3 charge sums, table per new particle class confirming kinetic+mass term + presence in total, one line naming total + summed terms, plus mixing-matrix hermiticity, InteractionOrder/ParameterType sweep, particle/parameter/term counts.
- Bash DENIED except `./frgen` / `./frgen *` (confirmed again — a `grep` bash call was rejected); use read/grep tools only. No cached reference `.fr` exists (rule 6 respected).
- Schema (frmodel.py) specifics: `ParticleClass.definitions` = List[str] verbatim rule strings; `Parameter.definitions` = List[Rule{lhs,rhs,delayed}]; unphysical classes: mass/pdg forbidden, definitions required; `quantum_numbers: Dict[str, NumberStr]`; External + ComplexParameter → error (complex couplings must be Internal+complex or External-real — schema wins over paper).
- render.py: `Mass -> {sym, value}` renders value verbatim (`Internal` passes through); External param whose name is a Mass/Width symbol is DROPPED from M$Parameters (`_reserved_mass_width_names`) — so mass symbols are NOT declared as Parameters; `declared` in lint includes Mass/Width spec tokens, so rule 15 is satisfied by the Mass spec value. Template model.fr.j2 = only `M$ModelName = "..."` + `{{ body }}` (no Load[SM]).
- fr_lint.py exact mechanics: `explicit_index_in_dc` regex `DC\[\s*(\w+)\[([^\]]*)\]\s*,` — stage `compile` if the field's Indices include Colour/Sextet/Gluon/Octet ⇒ NEVER write `DC[S1m13hatbar[aa], mu]`; use bare un-indexed fields in DC (passes lint; matches SM.fr `QLbar.Ga[mu].DC[QL, mu]`). `mixing_in_definitions`: fires when Definitions reference ≥2 phys classes AND text matches `\b(sa|ca|sin|cos|Sin|Cos|s\w*|c\w*)\w*\b` ⇒ colour dummy in Definitions MUST be `aa` (paper's `cc` would fire); `HC[W13mat[1,1]]`, capital-S names safe. `explicit_flavour_sum`: fires when `X[ff,ff] Xbar[` with X in our param_names — use matrix products. `nested_generation_index` banned. Undeclared-symbol check: token must be in `declared` (class names + `c+"bar"` variants + Mass/Width tokens); FR_BUILTINS covers `HC/CC/Eps/ExpandIndices/Module/...`. `_is_kin_name`: term name containing "kin" skips missing_interaction_order; DC/FS in body also satisfies it. One root; term defs start `^(L\w+)\s*:?=`; no `$` in names; particle names forbidden chars ``'` `` whitespace ``!@#%^&*()=[]{}|\;:<>?/,``; `SelfConjugate True` ⇒ no nonzero QuantumNumbers; low_class_index warns if <100. FR_SYMBOLS = {HC,CC,FS,DC,del,Eps,Ga,ProjP,ProjM,T,Sig,PauliSigma,IndexDelta,ME,Index,Indices,Mass,Width,Value,Unphysical,Abelian}; PROTECTED = {N,C,D,E,I,K,O,Pi,Gamma,Beta,Zeta,Sqrt,Exp,Log,Sin,Cos,Tan,Re,Im,Conjugate,Sum,Block,Module,Table,If,Which}.
- Paper FR field listing (lines ~1330–1366) CONFIRMED this session: physical `S[100] == {ClassName -> S1m13hat, Mass -> {m1m13hat, Internal}, Width -> {W1m13hat, Internal}, SelfConjugate -> False, PropagatorType -> ScalarDash, PropagatorArrow -> None, QuantumNumbers -> {Q -> -1/3}, Indices -> {Index[Colour]}, ParticleName -> "S1m13hat", AntiParticleName -> "S1m13hat~", FullName -> "S1m13hat"}`; unphysical `S[101] == {ClassName -> S1m13, Unphysical -> True, SelfConjugate -> False, QuantumNumbers -> {Y -> -1/3}, Indices -> {Index[Colour]}, Definitions -> {S1m13[cc_] :> HC[W13mat[1,1]] S1m13hat[cc] + HC[W13mat[2,1]] R2tm13hat[cc] + HC[W13mat[3,1]] S3m13hat[cc]}}` — unphysical carries NO Mass (schema forbids anyway); physical carries Q, unphysical carries Y.
- Paper has NO benchmark mass values (`grep GeV|benchmark` → only line 353: v ≈ 246 GeV) ⇒ mass values must be chosen (e.g. `"1500."`).
- Physics content: 5 SU2 reps all colour triplets: Φ1 (1, Y=−1/3), Φ~1 (1, Y=−4/3), Φ2 (2, Y=7/6), Φ~2 (2, Y=1/6), Φ3 (3, Y=−1/3); field names S1, R1, R2, R2t, S3; Phi = SM Higgs.
- Charge-sector/mixing structure (derived, needs name verification): −1/3 sector (3 states: S1m13hat, R2tm13hat, S3m13hat → W13mat 3×3, matches paper); +2/3 sector (3 states: R2p23hat, R2tp23hat?, S3p23hat → 3×3 W-matrix); −4/3 sector (2 states: R1m43hat?, S3m43hat → 2×2); +5/3 (R2p53hat alone, identity/trivial). Prior "S1m43hat"/"R2tm23hat" names are SUSPECTED MISREADS (Φ1 has only Q=−1/3; Φ~2 has +2/3 not −2/3) — MUST verify exact 9 eigenstate names + W-matrix names via paper grep.
- L^LQ = L_2Φ + L_kin + L_f + L_3Φ + L_4Φ; L_2Φ couplings: Y1..Y3, Yt1, Yt2, Y22, Yt2t2, Y33 (dim-4 real), A1t2, At23 (dim-1 complex), Y2t2, Yt13, Y13 (dim-0 complex) + bare masses m1, mt1, m2, mt2, m3; mass matrices (~725–733) m̂² = m² + v²/2·(Y ∓ |A|²/m²_ab); L_3Φ 8 implementable triples: A_1~2~2, A_~12~2, Y_1~12, Y_123, Y_1~23, Y_~123, Y_233, Y_~233; L_4Φ = SM-like Higgs quartic only; L_f: Y_a^{AB} 3×3 complex LQ–quark–lepton tensors, Y1QLL symmetric, Y~1QRR/Y3QLL antisymmetric, Y1QRR arbitrary, colour-ε for Y1QLL/Y1QRR, `+ h.c.` each; paper Lagrangian variable names: LQall, LQ2Phi, LQkin, LQf, LQ3Phi, LQ4Phi; repo https://gitlab.com/lucschnell/SLQrules.
- Mass-basis design SETTLED this session: hat classes get NUMERIC masses `Mass -> {m1m13hat, 1500.}` (numeric satisfies rule 15; mass sym lands in lint `declared` via Mass spec, not in M$Parameters); mirror paper `Width -> {W1m13hat, Internal}` (unused, not declared as params); hat free-field terms use bare fields `DC[S1m13hatbar, mu] DC[S1m13hat, mu] - m1m13hat^2 S1m13hatbar S1m13hat` (kin-named); L_2Φ EXCLUDES bare quadratic m² terms (would double-count with mandated hat mass terms after unphysical→hat rotation); bare masses m1, mt1, m2, mt2, m3 still declared External with numeric values but used in NO terms (lint rule 11 silent on unused params; document in self-audit).
- W-matrix params: External tensor with explicit per-component `value_rules`, identity-default values (defensible: paper sets all couplings unity); document unitarity/hermiticity caveat in audit.
- Names safe (no SM.fr/builtin collisions): S1, R1, R2, R2t, S3; 9 `...hat`; m1, mt1, m2, mt2, m3; Y1, Yt1, Y2, Yt2, Y3, Y22, Yt2t2, Y33, A1t2, At23, Y2t2, Yt13, Y13, Y1RR, Y1LL, Y1QLL, Y1QRR, Yt1RR, Yt1QRR, Y2RL, Y2LR, Yt2RL, Y3LL, Y3QLL; avoid SM params ee, gs, gw, g1, sw, cw, vev, MZ, MW, MH, yl, yu, yd, lam, CKM, muH, cabi.

## Work State
### Completed
- TASK.md fully read (twice); rules 1–15 + self-audit format captured with exact rule-1/14/15 wording.
- Paper: 1–1508 incl. LQ Lagrangian 539–1199, Methods 1209–1404, FR field listing ~1246–1410 (physical S[100] + unphysical S[101] structures captured verbatim — former blocker resolved), L_f table 993–1015; 2596–3795, 3796–4995, ~5016–5060, 6410–6477; appendix skipped.

- Free-field term form DECIDED: bare un-indexed fields inside `DC[...]` (lint-safe, sanctioned by rule-1 template).

## Next Move
